parsed.rationale: Both records are `type-alias-object` kinds with empty `fields_or_signature` lists and no shared structural evidence (Jaccard, shared fields, and shared ancestor are all null). The two files live in entirely separate app targets — `app:WatchXYC` (`WXYC/WatchXYC/RootTabView.swift`) and `app:iOS` (`WXYC/iOS/Views/Root/RootTabView.swift`) — which are platform-distinct entry points (watchOS vs. iOS). A `RootTabView` is a natural, idiomatic name for the top-level tab container on each platform; the name collision is purely coincidental and the implementations are expected to diverge by platform. Merging or extracting them would couple platform-specific UI code inappropriately.
